ingredient_class._doc: Class of a crafting INGREDIENT that is not a candidate itself (no recipe, e.g. cobweb, ores, plants). A recipe excludes its result as EASY only if every ingredient is EASY; a LIMITED ingredient makes the craft a LIMITED source instead (the result stays eligible). Items without an entry and without a recipe default to EASY and are listed in the report's Needs owner review.
